title: Immunotherapy for canine oral melanoma
notes: Current Ohio State treatment study using intratumoral weakened LCMV followed by collection/expansion of tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, with reinfusion if metastatic/progressive disease develops. Public criteria require localized confirmed oral melanoma accessible to injection/biopsy; a randomized control arm does not receive the virus injection but remains eligible for immune-cell collection/reinfusion if disease progresses.
